description: This file defines an Android activity called DeviceListActivity that displays a list of Bluetooth devices, both paired and discovered during runtime. It manages Bluetooth discovery, registers broadcast receivers for device discovery events, and handles user interactions for selecting a device, passing back its MAC address to the calling activity.

classes.name: DeviceListActivity
classes.description: An Activity that shows a list of Bluetooth devices—both paired and discovered during Bluetooth scanning, allowing user to select one and returning its MAC address.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, registers Bluetooth discovery receivers, and populates paired devices list.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters receivers and stops ongoing Bluetooth discovery when the activity is destroyed.

methods.name: doDiscovery
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth device discovery, managing UI updates to indicate scanning.
